title: The Corporation, Capitalism, and Globalization
description: Drawing on world systems, Marxist, network, and postcolonial perspectives, the course examines capitalism and the contradictions and conflicts that shape it. Topics include: the role of transnational corporations and financial markets; the development of transnational classes, governance and the culture industry; and social alternatives ranging from localization to post-capitalism on a global scale.
recommendations: SOCI 215 recommended prior to SOCI 355.Recommended prior to SOCI 419.
